about: Which sibling bytes each audit row recorded, for replays under EXPEDITION_ROOT. Checked offline by verification/check_expedition_root.py. 'audited' holds only values the ledger row itself records. The ledger rows mostly do not say which file a value hashes or how, so each audited hash names the file and the hash kind that the check script the row cites uses, with the script lines that show it; the checker confirms the value, the file name and the recipe appear on those lines. 'post_audit_reference' holds public bytes committed after the audits, kept so a replay can say which public version it ran; they are not the audited bytes. 'unrecorded' names every row that records no byte pin. Nothing here back-fills an audited value.

hash_kinds.file bytes: SHA-256 of the file's raw bytes
hash_kinds.canonical JSON: SHA-256 of the JSON re-serialised with json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) after the top-level sha256_canonical field is removed; that field must equal the result. This is the recipe of check_007 lines 82-89 and check_011 lines 66-73.
